description: This file provides functions and classes for managing plugin facade modules, including resolving module paths, loading modules dynamically with caching, handling configuration snapshots, and controlling access to bundled plugin surfaces within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolveSourceFirstPublicSurfacePath
methods.description: Resolves the first existing source file path for a given artifact basename and directory, checking multiple extensions.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleLocation
methods.description: Determines the module path and boundary root for a plugin facade, preferring source files or bundled paths based on context.

methods.name: getJiti
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached Jiti loader instance configured for a specific module path.

methods.name: readFacadeBoundaryConfigSafely
methods.description: Safely reads the runtime configuration snapshot or boundary config file, returning a default if unavailable.

methods.name: getFacadeBoundaryResolvedConfig
methods.description: Resolves and caches the boundary configuration, including plugin activation states and auto-enabled reasons.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginManifestRecordByDirName
methods.description: Finds the plugin manifest record for a given directory name from the plugin registry.

methods.name: resolveTrackedFacadePluginId
methods.description: Resolves the plugin ID for a given directory name, defaulting to the directory name if not found.

methods.name: resolveBundledPluginPublicSurfaceAccess
methods.description: Determines if access to a bundled plugin's public surface is allowed based on configuration and activation state.

methods.name: createLazyFacadeValueLoader
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader function that caches its result after the first invocation.

methods.name: createLazyFacadeProxyValue
methods.description: Creates a proxy object that lazily resolves its target value upon property access.

methods.name: loadBundledPluginPublicSurfaceModuleSync
methods.description: Synchronously loads a bundled plugin's public surface module, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: canLoadActivatedBundledPluginPublicSurface
methods.description: Checks if a bundled plugin's public surface can be loaded based on current activation state.

methods.name: loadActivatedBundledPluginPublicSurfaceModuleSync
methods.description: Loads a bundled plugin's public surface module if access is allowed, throwing if blocked.

methods.name: tryLoadActivatedBundledPluginPublicSurfaceModuleSync
methods.description: Attempts to load a bundled plugin's public surface module, returning null if access is blocked.

methods.name: listImportedBundledPluginFacadeIds
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all loaded facade plugin IDs.

methods.name: resetFacadeRuntimeStateForTest
methods.description: Resets internal caches and state for testing purposes.
